tables.name: kLiraTable_Nodes_Coordinates
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains number of node and coordinates of node

tables.name: kLiraTable_Elements_TypeAndNodes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains number of element, its finite element type and numbers of nodes at each vertex of element

tables.name: kLiraTable_Nodes_Restraints
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains number of node and 1 if the node is restrained by X, Y, Z, UX, UY, UZ, W

tables.name: kLiraTable_Plates_C1C2
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of plate element, its subgrade reaction moduli C1z, C2z as well as a value of load Pz and number of its subgroup to pass Pz into SOIL module for further calculations

tables.name: kLiraTable_Bars_C1C2
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of bar element, its subgrade reaction moduli C1z, C2z, C1y, C2y as well as width Bc and height Hc of the bar relevant to them. If the bar has a standard cross section and Bc=B column is 1, Bc will be obtained from the wi

tables.name: kLiraTable_Special_C1C2
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of finite element type 53 or 54 and their of C1z, C2z and Fi values

tables.name: kLiraTable_NonlinearDiagrams
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a non-linear law: its type, number of record (of the type) and parameters

tables.name: kLiraTable_Stiffnesses
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a stiffness of finite elements: its number, type, comment, parameters, references to non-linear laws and positions of reinforcement for non-linear analysis

tables.name: kLiraTable_Elements_Stiffnesses
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of finite element and number of its stiffness

tables.name: kLiraTable_PRBs
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a perfect rigid body (PRB): its number, a number of a its principal node and numbers of the rest of its of nodes

tables.name: kLiraTable_Plates_Offsets
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a plate finite element and a value of its offset

tables.name: kLiraTable_CoupledDOFs
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a coupled DOFs group, DOF directions and numbers of its nodes

tables.name: kLiraTable_Bars_Offsets
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a bar finite element and a value of its offset

tables.name: kLiraTable_Bars_Hinges
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a bar finite element, and a value of its hinge

tables.name: kLiraTable_Nodes_LocalAxes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a node and a value of its angle of rotation of the local axes Y1, Z1 around the axis X1

tables.name: kLiraTable_Bars_LocalAxes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a bar finite element and parameters specifying the orientation of local axes

tables.name: kLiraTable_Plates_LocalAxes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a plate finite element and parameters specifying the orientation of local axes

tables.name: kLiraTable_Plates_AxesOfOrthotropy
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a plate finite element and parameters specifying the orientation of axes of orthotropy

tables.name: kLiraTable_Solids_LocalAxes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a solid finite element and parameters specifying the orientation of local axes

tables.name: kLiraTable_Solids_AxesOfOrthotropy
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of a solid finite element and parameters specifying the orientation of axes of orthotropy

tables.name: kLiraTable_Elements_DesignSectionsCount
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of element and numbers of its points where forces or stresses are calculated

tables.name: kLiraTable_AssemblageStages
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of assemblage stage, list of assembled elements, list of disassembled elements

tables.name: kLiraTable_DCL
tables.description: Input table. It represents particular DCL table. Each row contains a different data depending on parameters

tables.name: kLiraTable_LoadCases
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about load cases

tables.name: kLiraTable_Bars_InternalForces
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about internal forces in a bar finite element

tables.name: kLiraTable_CollectionOfMasses
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about Masses

tables.name: kLiraTable_Stiffnesses_Factors
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about rigidity factors

tables.name: kLiraTable_ConstructionAxes
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about construction axes

tables.name: kLiraTable_ElevationMarks
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about elevation marks

tables.name: kLiraTable_StructuralBlocks
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains the information about structural blocks

tables.name: kLiraTable_Elements_Materials
tables.description: Input table. Each row contains a number of finite element and the appropriate information about material

ILiraApplication.name: OpenDocument
ILiraApplication.description: Opens document of path PathName. If RestoreEnv parameter is not 0, also restores from *.LIR-file additional initial data files. If Silent parameter is not 0, overwrites them silently. Errors and warnings are returned with parameters pMsgs

ILiraApplication.name: CreateNewDocument
ILiraApplication.description: Create a new document of specified Title, SystemLabel and Description. Please refer the corresponding properties of LiraDocument object for limitations on the parameters

ILiraApplication.name: ActiveDocument
ILiraApplication.description: Active document of null if no documents are opened

ILiraApplication.name: StartCmd
ILiraApplication.description: Starts a command with identifier Cmd

ILiraApplication.name: MeasurementUnits
ILiraApplication.description: Units of measurement all tables use

ILiraApplication.name: StartAnalysis
ILiraApplication.description: Starts analysis of a problem in file PathName. Does not wait until the end of the analysis, returns immediately after the analysis is started. Returns nonzero  if succeeded. Errors will appear in PackageAnalysisLog.TXT file in LIRA-FEM work directory

ILiraApplication.name: StartUnzip
ILiraApplication.description: Start unzipping a LIRA-FEM archive. ZipPathName is a path to it. Does not wait until archive is completely unzipped, returns immediately

ILiraApplication.name: StartZip
ILiraApplication.description: Start creating a LIRA-FEM archive. Parameters: PathName -- path to LIRA-FEM document to zip. ZipPathName -- path to the newly created zip file. ZipMode -- what data are to zip. Does not wait until archive is completely created, returns immediately

ILiraApplication.name: DeleteResults
ILiraApplication.description: Deletes all analysis results for the LIRA-FEM document of path PathName

ILiraApplication.name: ImportFile
ILiraApplication.description: Imports file Path. LirFileTemplate specifies a template finite element model which can not contain nodes, element or stiffnesses

ILiraApplication.name: StartAnalysisOnServer
ILiraApplication.description: Starts analysis of a problem in file PathName on current analysis server. Does not wait until the end of the analysis, returns immediately after the problem is queued. Returns nonzero if succeeded

ILiraApplication.name: UnLock
ILiraApplication.description: Allows lirasapr.exe to unload if references to all its objects are freed. If this method was not called, lirasapr.exe runs even after references to all its objects are freed. Opened documents are not saved

ILiraDocument.name: Application
ILiraDocument.description: LIRA-FEM application object

ILiraDocument.description: Name of this document. Can not have symbols ,.<>()#?*|\/: and length over 30 symbols

ILiraDocument.name: Title
ILiraDocument.description: Name of this document. Can not have symbols ,.<>()#?*|\/: and length over 30 symbols

ILiraDocument.name: SystemLabel
ILiraDocument.description: System label of the finite element model contained in this document

ILiraDocument.name: SystemLabel
ILiraDocument.description: System label of the finite element model contained in this document

ILiraDocument.name: Description
ILiraDocument.description: Description of this document. Can not have length over 255 symbols

ILiraDocument.name: Description
ILiraDocument.description: Description of this document. Can not have length over 255 symbols

ILiraDocument.name: LoadsValsType
ILiraDocument.description: Load values type of this document

ILiraDocument.name: LoadsValsType
ILiraDocument.description: Load values type of this document

ILiraDocument.name: Activate
ILiraDocument.description: Makes this document active

ILiraDocument.name: IsModified
ILiraDocument.description: Returns true if this document was modified and false otherwise

ILiraDocument.name: Save
ILiraDocument.description: Saves this document. SaveEnv parameter allows to save copies of additional initial data files this document refers. The copies are saved inside this document on disc. The document must be active. User interface messages can be shown

ILiraDocument.name: SaveAs
ILiraDocument.description: Saves this document with specified PathName. SaveEnv parameter allows to save copies of additional initial data files this document refers. The copies are saved inside this document on disc. The document must be active. Messages from UI can be shown

ILiraDocument.name: PathName
ILiraDocument.description: Path and name of the document file

ILiraDocument.name: Close
ILiraDocument.description: Closes this document

ILiraDocument.name: Select
ILiraDocument.description: Selects objects of type Subj with specified Numbers in the model. Numbers can be an array of VARIANTs, INTs or a string like 1 3 5-8. To select all objects of the type, specify Numbers as string 'all'. If some numbers do no exist or are hidden, returns them as

ILiraDocument.name: Unselect
ILiraDocument.description: Unselects objects of type Subj with specified Numbers in the model. Numbers can be an array of VARIANTs, INTs or a string like 1 3 5-8. To unselect all objects of the type, specify Numbers as string 'all'. If some numbers do no exist or are hidden, returns the

ILiraDocument.name: GetSelection
ILiraDocument.description: Returns currently selected objects of type Subj. The supported return types are array of VARIANTs, array of INTs or string like 1 3 5-8. The desired return type may be specified in pNumbers parameter before call of this function

ILiraDocument.name: AllTables
ILiraDocument.description: All input tables of this document

ILiraDocument.name: SetGenerateCsvTables
ILiraDocument.description: Sets if to generate CSV-tables of results during analysis of this document. You can choose the CSV-tables to generate providing CsvTableArray parameter as an array of LiraCsvTableEnum enumeration members. To start analysis, call StartAnalysis method of LiraApp

ILiraDocument.name: GetGenerateCsvTables
ILiraDocument.description: Returns if to generate CSV-tables of results during analysis of this document. You can provide the pCsvTableArray parameter to retrieve an array of the generated CSV-tables as members of LiraCsvTableEnum enumerator. To start analysis, call StartAnalysis method

ILiraDocument.name: CurrentLoadCase
ILiraDocument.description: Sets or returns a 1-based number of the current load case of initial data (or assembly stage if applies)

ILiraDocument.name: CurrentLoadCase
ILiraDocument.description: Sets or returns a 1-based number of the current load case of initial data (or assembly stage if applies)

ILiraDocument.name: SetDeadWeightLoad
ILiraDocument.description: Adds or deletes self weight loads on finite elements whose cross sections have non-zero material density. Flags parameter specifies the requred action and its options. Flags parameter is a combination of LiraDeadWeightLoadEnum bits. Yf parameter is the safety

ILiraDocument.name: SetSoilModel
ILiraDocument.description: Attaches to this document soil model with full path SldFilePath and passes its options to this document. If this parameter is empty, detaches previously attached soil model. Group parameter is the number of a load group created or updated in the soil model fro

ILiraDocument.name: GetSoilModel
ILiraDocument.description: Returns the full path SldFilePath of the soil model previously attached to this document. Also returns the other parameters previously specified for the soil model

ILiraTables.name: Document
ILiraTables.description: Document that owns this item of input table group

ILiraTables.name: CreateNewItem
ILiraTables.description: Creates a new input table of type Typ and name Nam for the part of the model ModelPart and places it in position AtPos. AtPos can be a value from 0 to ItemCount. If AtPos=-1, appends it. See LiraTableEnum for description of Pars

ILiraTables.name: InsertCopy
ILiraTables.description: Inserts a copy of Item and places it in position AtPos. AtPos can be a value from 0 to ItemCount. If AtPos=-1, appends it. Item can belong to any of opened documents

ILiraTables.name: BeginGroupAction
ILiraTables.description: Starts a series of command on input tables or their groups

ILiraTables.name: EndGroupAction
ILiraTables.description: Ends a series of command started with BeginGroupAction() method. GroupActionName gives the name for Undo command

ILiraTables.name: CopyTo
ILiraTables.description: Copies pItem from this document to the other document pDst

ILiraTable.name: Document
ILiraTable.description: Document that owns this item of input table group

ILiraTable.name: SetContents
ILiraTable.description: Replaces all contents of this table with Data. Data is a two-dimension array of VARIANTs: Dim Data(MaxRow, MaxColumn), one VARIANT per cell. Also Data can be a tab-separated multi-line string

ILiraTable.name: GetContents
ILiraTable.description: Returns all contents of this table. pData is a two-dimension array of VARIANTs: Dim pData(MaxRow, MaxColumn). pData can also be a tab-separated multi-line string. The desired return type may be specified in pData parameter before call of this function

ILiraTable.name: InitialModelPart
ILiraTable.description: Part of finite element model displayed in this table

ILiraTable.name: SaveInitialModelPictureEmf
ILiraTable.description: Saves the picture of the finite element model at the moment when this table was created to the file FilePath. The format of the picture is EMF

ILiraTable.name: FindSelection
ILiraTable.description: Returns numbers of rows (zero-based) corresponding the current selection in the FE model. The supported return types are array of VARIANTs or array of INTs. The desired return type may be specified in pRows parameter before call of this function

ILiraTable.name: SelectOnModel
ILiraTable.description: Selects in the FE model objects that correspond row numbers (zero-based) passed in Rows parameter. Rows can be an array of VARIANTs or array of INTs

ILiraTable.name: IsModified
ILiraTable.description: Modification flag. It is true if the contents table was modified after creation or last successful call of Apply() method or false otherwise

ILiraTable.name: Apply
ILiraTable.description: Applies contents of this table to the owning FE model. Clears IsModified flag of the table. Returns non-zero if succeeded or 0 otherwise. pErrs receives errors if any. Error format: "Row_No\tColumn_No\tError_Text\r\n" where \t, \r\n are tab and EOL

ILiraTable.name: RefillFromModel
ILiraTable.description: Cancels all modification made to this table and refills its contents from the current state of owning finite element model
